About Our Company

Shri Shyam Astrology Vedic jyotish ke anubhavi acharyon ke saath ghar baithe salah deta hai. Hum kundli, matching, career, prem aur parivar ke vishayon par spasht margdarshan dete hain.

Agar aap kisi bhi desh se sachchi aur result-oriented salah dhoondh rahe hain, to yahan experienced panditon se baat kijiye. Yeh vidya peedhiyon se chali aa rahi hai.

Our Story

FAQ

Janmkundli aur grahon ki sthiti se vivah yog samjhai jaati hai.
Kundli ki dasha aur yog kabhi-kabhi raste mein rukawat daalte hain.
Grahon, yog aur dasha se sehat ke sanket dekha jaata hai.
Kundli ke graha, yog aur dasha dekhkar un kshetron ka sujhav diya jaata hai.
Lagna, dasha aur grahon se yeh dekha jaata hai ki kaunsi naukri shubh ho sakti hai.
Dono kundliyon ke milan aur vivah yog dekhkar sambandh ki sambhavna batayi jaati hai.
Dhan se jude grahon aur dasha ka adhyayan karke samay aur upay samjhaye jaate hain.
Kundli janm samay ka aakashi chitra hai. Kai log ise zindagi ke faislon ke liye upyogi maante hain.

How chatting with an astrologer can help you

Jab sawal dimag mein ghumte rehte hain, to jawab ek WhatsApp message door ho sakta hai.

Zindagi ke uchchav-nichav mein Shani ya Rahu dasha jaise samay vishesh savdhani maangte hain.

Sirf samasya-samadhan hi nahi — shaadi ka shubh muhurat, naamkaran, mundan ya rashi ke anuroop ratna ke liye bhi salah milti hai.
